$comment: The acceptance gate fails on any compact-health problem that is NOT listed here.
An entry means: this degradation is known, has an owner record, and must not page.
It does NOT mean the problem is acceptable forever -- expiresAt forces a re-review,
and the gate fails outright once that date passes.
A temporary rollout entry may add an entry-level `expiresAt` bounded to the first
scheduled cron window. At or after that instant, its live problem blocks even when
the root expiresAt is later. A health-probe cutover requires either a completed
Railway-side pre-seed or this owner-bound, expiring acknowledgement.
Entries are matched on name:status exactly. A source that recovers is reported as
'recovered' on the next run (prune it); a source that fails with a DIFFERENT status
than the one baselined is treated as new and blocks, which is the point.
Every entry carries a real tracking issue, never the PR that introduced the entry:
a merged PR closes, and a suppression pointing at a closed PR has no owner.
Softening fault statuses is the marketImplications blind spot the ON_DEMAND_KEYS policy
block in api/health.js exists to prevent.

acknowledged.name: mineralProduction
acknowledged.reason: New USGS/BGS mineral-production probe. seed-bundle-static-ref runs daily at 03:00 UTC (`0 3 * * *` in scripts/railway-services.json), so the key cannot exist until the first tick after this PR deploys; EMPTY is expected until then. Anchored to that real cron window: MAX_ROLLOUT_WINDOW_MS caps firstScheduledRunAt-activatedAt at 24h, and a daily tick fits inside it. If this PR has not merged by 2026-08-14T03:00Z, re-anchor both to the next 03:00 UTC tick.

acknowledged.name: bocValet
acknowledged.reason: New Bank of Canada Valet probe. seed-bundle-macro cron is 0 8 * * * (08:00 UTC); first scheduled run after this acknowledgement is 2026-08-15T08:00:00.000Z. EMPTY is expected until that publish. Re-anchored because the previous 2026-08-14T08:00Z window expires today before merge. The expiry equals firstScheduledRunAt so EMPTY after that run is a real problem.

acknowledged.name: statcanWds
acknowledged.reason: New Statistics Canada WDS probe. seed-bundle-macro cron is 0 8 * * * (08:00 UTC = 04:00 ET), before StatCan ~08:30 ET. Toronto-today getChangedCubeList returns HTTP 409 "The product is not released yet" until that window, so the first 08:00 UTC tick is not a successful publish even after treating 409 as empty and falling back to yesterday. Slipped past post-08:30 ET the same way Ontario 511 EMPTY was slipped: expires at 2026-08-16T13:00:00.000Z (09:00 ET on 2026-08-16). EMPTY is expected until then. The expiry equals firstScheduledRunAt so EMPTY after that instant is a real problem. Issue #6676 (BoC remains #6616).
